Hear the hope that competition between powers will pass.
Read the reported example of the apostles as teachers of glad tidings.
Consider the stated relationship to a particular peace congress.
Read the assessment of a religious congress in its particular setting.
Keep the description of a book concerning justice and humanity’s comfort.
shortened: As for the book you had written about, this was written concerning political matters to promote justice and fairness and bring about the comfort of humanity.

order.why: Read the caution about composing a law and the stated motive of goodwill.
Consider the affirmation of women’s equal humanity beside political detachment.
shortened: Regarding women's suffrage, this is a political issue and I am detached from all political matters, however I will say this much: both men and women are human and are like two wings for the world of humanity.

order.why: Keep the historical counsel to women’s gatherings in its own circumstances.
shortened: In America, the cradle of women's liberation, women are still debarred from political institutions because they squabble. They are yet to have a member in the House of Representatives. Also Baha'u'llah hath proclaimed: "O ye men of the House of Justice." Ye need to be calm and composed, so that the work will proceed with wisdom, otherwise there will be such chaos that ye will leave everything and run away. "This newly born babe is traversing in one night the path that needeth a hundred years to tread." In brief, ye should now engage in matters of pure spirituality and not contend with men.

order.why: Read the distinction between correspondence with a count and agreement with his politics.
shortened: I hope that in all instances thou wilt be confirmed and assisted in rendering service to the Abha Threshold---may my life be a sacrifice to His loved ones---and that thou wilt correspond with the aforesaid count. It would do no harm to send him the translation of certain Tablets that are appropriate to his circumstances and agreeable to his taste: yet not in such a manner that the Russian state would suspect that thou art in agreement and concert with him in all principles---even that of involvement in political affairs, for the aforesaid Count is extremely involved in political affairs.

order.why: Consider moderation in speaking with a politically involved person.
shortened: This person is purely political. The friends, like Shaykh Farajullah, must speak with him with wisdom and moderation. All their conversations should be solely about the oneness of the human world, fellowship and harmony between different peoples, and the elimination of conflict and strife, nothing more.

order.why: Read concern about titles that may create suspicion.
Consider a reputation for truthfulness as a means of being understood.
Read the rejection of an expectation of Arab political leadership after imprisonment.
Keep peace and human welfare as the reported public purpose.
Read the reported rejection of intrigue with its source omission retained.
shortened: Praise be to God that it had become evident and known to all that the Baha'is are free from any intrigues and seditions. They confer life and not death...

order.why: Consider law and order in contrast with revolutionary sedition.
shortened: The Baha'is must not engage in political movements which lead to sedition. They must interest themselves in movements which conduce to law and order. In Persia at the present time the Baha'is have no part in the revolutionary upheavals which have terminated in lawlessness and rebellion.

order.why: Read the instruction against political affiliation.
Keep withdrawal from parties and friction together.
shortened: I had written to the friends from the beginning that they should distance themselves from all political parties, and shun every friction, they should entrust the affairs of this material world to those whose concern is the mundane matters of this earth, and leave its politics to the statesmen.

order.why: Consider offering counsel while refusing party alliance.
shortened: In any case, we have nothing to do with political matters. We mind our own business and offer counsel - whoever wishes may act upon it and whoever wishes may leave it. The friends of God must keep aloof from all and abhor any dispute and conflict. They must obey the government and be well-wishers of all, neither associating with any party nor allying with any group. To them belong war and strife and conflict, to us belong peace and tranquility and moderation.

order.why: Read the counsel against political confidences and criticism in its context.
shortened: They neither share confidences with politicians nor associate with freedom-seekers, neither thinking of government nor occupied with criticizing any of the people.
They should not interfere in any matter nor engage in any political question.

order.why: Hear the instruction to attend to one’s work.
Keep sanctity and detachment in the account of daily affairs.
Read concentration on teaching in place of political interference.
Hear the concise account of remembrance and noninvolvement.
Keep the stated textual basis of the instruction.
Read the reiterated prohibition in its own letter.
shortened: But in political matters, as before, do not interfere at all, for by the decisive text of the Blessed Beauty, interference is forbidden.

order.why: Retain the shortest statement as a distinct source.
Keep the separately reported instruction.
shortened: Don't talk about politics. Speak about the good work the English have done in Egypt.

order.why: Read the extension to domestic and foreign matters.
Consider the instruction about private discussion.
shortened: In any case, the divine friends must, as before, not interfere in political matters.
The divine friends must not discuss politics even in private.

order.why: Read words, deeds, stories, and reports within this counsel.
Consider the request to make the community’s position explicit in addresses.
Read the renewed warning in a letter to the communities.
shortened: O servants of the Abha Beauty!

Letters have been written on many occasions and to all the communities as well as to individual believers on this most important matter stating that according to the sacred texts the Baha'is should not interfere in politics even to the extent of uttering a single word. It is self-evident that the only impregnable stronghold, the only protection is the word of God itself. Now it is necessary to insist on this matter again, to admonish the friends most seriously and emphasise once more that the believers in God should not interfere in political matters should not even engage in debate on such issues.

order.why: Place withdrawal from factions in the tempest of Iran’s upheaval.
Read the explicit refusal of both constitutionalist and absolutist affiliation.
shortened: From the beginning of the revolution in Tehran, it was announced to all regions, especially the Land of Ta, that the Party of God has no involvement in political affairs and has no complaint or praise for the governments of the world. We stand apart from all parties and, with tear-filled eyes, seek the Lord's grace and bounty for all peoples and nations. We are neither intimate companions of the constitutionalists nor allies of the absolutists. We are impartial and unbiased, serving without reward or recompense, occupied with the holy fragrances and familiar with spiritual attractions.
We are commanded to obey the government and abhor all conflict and hostility.

order.why: Consider conflicting accusations directed at a nonaligned community.
Read the call to demonstrate the previously stated position.
shortened: The divine friends must collectively make it clear to all that from the beginning of these successive upheavals it was repeatedly written that the friends of God must never interfere in political affairs but must remain aloof and wish well to both sides, and show the letters that were written in this regard.

order.why: Keep the account of nonparticipation in active societies.
shortened: In this general movement in Iran, it became clear and evident that not a single Baha'i was among the active societies. Rather, all kept their distance and did not interfere in political affairs, but engaged in obedience to the government and well-wishing toward the nation.

order.why: Read reform and unity alongside withdrawal when those efforts failed.
shortened: Regarding political events, explain to the authorities that this oppressed community has remained aloof from all parties since the beginning of the revolution, and has always strived for reform and unity, and when unable to achieve this, withdrew.

order.why: Consider the absence of affinity or enmity in the period of despotism.
shortened: Praise be to God that the friends in this upheaval are distinguished from other parties - they are without ulterior motives or illness and stay clear of all conflict and strife. In the time of despotism they had neither affinity with the dominant government nor enmity with other parties. They were well-wishers of all and sincere lovers of the masses.

order.why: Keep the refusal to join warfare in the Persian Revolution explicit.
Read the criticism of destructive parties as the letter’s historical assessment.
shortened: Each of the parties took up a pickaxe and struck at the foundation of Iran until they destroyed it. The only party that was not a partner and participant in the destruction was this oppressed party.

order.why: Consider the source’s explanation of the danger expected from nationalist victory.
shortened: Some ignorant ones criticized 'Abdu'l-Baha, asking why, given the despotism of government forces, He did not assist the nationalists. If 'Abdu'l-Baha had assisted them, they would have triumphed in a short time, but the first thing they would have done would have been to kill the friends of God.

order.why: Read the detailed account of protective measures and the invocation of bada.
Keep the explanation of reserved judgment and future understanding in its source setting.
shortened: These matters depend upon divine wisdom, and cannot be explicitly set forth.  It is not that 'Abdu'l-Baha is unaware of the reality of things or that matters are unclear to Him, but it is due to the wisdom of the Cause. Let these events pass. Thereafter the wisdom thereof shall become plain and manifest, and at that time all shall testify that whatsoever was said was in conformity with wisdom. The mysteries of the letters of 'Abdu'l-Baha, His prohibition against interference in political affairs, and His exposition of the consummate wisdom thereof, shall in days to come be made clear and evident.

order.why: Read the assessment of personal motives as a particular historical judgment.
Attend to the critique of corruption and the friends’ preoccupation with minor disputes.
shortened: And the friends of God are also asleep while these slanderous souls have penetrated into the roots of various parties and do not let Iran find peace, and they commit whatever corruption they wish while the country's leaders are completely heedless of this matter and the friends of God are also silent and occupied with disputes over minor affairs.

order.why: Consider the explanation addressed to Ottoman officials and its strict disciplinary language.
shortened: The intention is that you should properly explain to the officers of the eternal Ottoman government that the people of God absolutely do not interfere in political matters - they are forbidden by explicit text. If any person from this community interferes in political affairs, others must shun him and even disassociate from him. The proof of this is that during these agitations, corruptions and formation of assemblies that took place in Tehran, the Baha'is absolutely did not interfere or go near them.

order.why: Keep the particular message to named recipients about affiliations.
Read sincerity toward government and distance from agitators.
shortened: In any case, the friends must act with complete sincerity toward the government, stay away from the agitators, and remain aloof from all parties.

order.why: Consider the instruction concerning societies and political parties.
shortened: In any case, the friends must show perfect obedience and submission to the government. They must not associate with any society at any time, nor harmonize with political parties. They must not interfere in political matters whatsoever.

order.why: Read withdrawal amid regional factional disorder.
shortened: Regarding the disorder and differences among the parties in those regions that you wrote about - the party of God must withdraw from all and never interfere. Leave them to their vain pursuits.

order.why: Keep the concise request to stand apart from these differences.
Read reliance and steadfastness amid difficulties.
shortened: Now the divine friends, with illumined hearts and spiritual feelings and merciful souls, praise be to God, are in the utmost joy and gladness and should take refuge from all difficulties, interventions and opposition in reliance upon the Ancient Truth, seek recourse to the Great Announcement, remain firm in the mighty Covenant, walk the straight path, and not interfere in political affairs.

order.why: Hear the call for calm and composure.
Keep the instruction and reported response together.
Read the acknowledgment of composure and noninterference.
Keep the reported account of fulfilling duties.
Read the source’s description of obedience and service to sovereigns.
shortened: All regions testify that this community is pure and innocent of political matters, and the Ancient Beauty - may my spirit be sacrificed for His loved ones - in all Tablets, Scriptures, Books and Treatises explicitly forbade the loved ones from involvement in political affairs and commanded all to obedience, submission, truthfulness and service to sovereigns.

order.why: Retain the brief explanation of noninvolvement.
Consider the confidential reassurance to a particular person.
Read the allegation concerning reports to foreign powers as an allegation.
Keep the response to accusations beside the focus on morals and conduct.
shortened: Regarding the matter thou didst write about - that the opponents aim to accuse the Baha'is - glory be to God! Could such a calumny be possible? No, by God! For according to the decisive sacred texts we are commanded to obey the present government and we have absolutely no involvement in political affairs and express no opinions thereon. We are commanded to spiritual matters which pertain to the realm of morals and conduct. We have no quarrel with anyone and no dispute with any soul.

order.why: Consider the source’s account of protection through abstention.
Read protection together with serving humanity and seeking the good of all.
shortened: This preservation, protection, security and comfort was due to the blessing of the sacred teachings, whereby the friends of God in no region interfered in political affairs, but rather spent their time in supplication and prayer, turning to the glorious Kingdom, striving for the good of all, serving humanity, experiencing spiritual attractions and divine inspirations.

order.why: Consider the hope for trust from governments.
Read the severe reported counsel given amid danger in Iran.
Keep the reported prohibition in its historical setting.
Read the assessment of successive consultative efforts as the report’s contemporary judgment.
Retain the reported account of remaining outside revolutions and its source omission.
Consider the critique of political tricks and their atmosphere.
Read the reported effect of personal interests on associates.
shortened: On the contrary, those who were absorbed by personal interests or political affairs degraded not only themselves but their associates.

order.why: Keep the link to faith and sacrifice with the source omission visible.
shortened: That which is an essential prerequisite of faith and certitude to abstain from interference in party politics and to sacrifice thine all in the path of the Lord of Lords....

order.why: Turn to the boundaries set for the consultative assembly.
Read the particular restriction concerning local government.
shortened: Likewise, that spiritual gathering must strictly avoid interference in political matters that concern the local government. They must not even breathe a word about political affairs.

order.why: Join the prevention of sedition with love and tranquility.
shortened: Fifth is preventing all from that which causes sedition and corruption, complete non-interference in political affairs, refraining from conversation in this regard even to the slightest degree, and indicating submission in all conditions and tranquility and love and friendship with all.

order.why: Consider the Spiritual Assembly’s defined responsibilities.
Read consultation on spiritual matters within those responsibilities.
Keep the historical membership direction for the Hands of the Cause.
Consider the naming of a spiritual gathering to avoid a governmental misunderstanding.
Read the dissolution of a meeting amid rumors about its purpose.
Consider love, kindness, and human oneness as the convention’s foundation.
shortened: This Convention will expand in the future and will surpass all conventions of the world, for it is a heavenly Convention, it is divine, its foundation is love and kindness and the promotion of the oneness of the human world and non-interference in political affairs.

order.why: Read the prohibition concerning political discussion in public meetings.
Keep the reported counsel to the editors of Star of the West.
Read the specific warning concerning a newspaper and its expected consequences.
Consider the instruction to an author about a proposed book.
Read the call to compose a history centered on neutrality.
Read the response to an inquiry about constitutional government.
Keep the repeated declaration of noninterference and its source omission.
Consider the refusal to answer a question placed outside the speaker’s duties.
Keep the particular reference to division of the Red Sea in its source wording.
Read the specific instruction regarding the President of the Republic.
Distinguish commercial trustworthiness from providing political information.
Read the reported counsel against speaking evil.
Consider the proposed subjects of speech: spiritual life, joy, and renewal.
Keep the source’s broad instruction concerning worldly leaders and affairs.
Read the answer to an inquiry about Socialist party membership.
Conclude the linked readings with neutrality, kindness, and the repeated position.
shortened: But it was written to all that they must show complete obedience to the government and remain neutral and show kindness to all parties but never interfere in disputes and conflicts.

In any case, the divine friends must completely abstain from interference, and whoever interferes in political matters even with a single word will surely fall into great difficulties, for they will have violated the divine text. You should prohibit everyone from interference. We maintain our original position and absolutely no change or alteration will occur in our thought or view.

order.why: Read the supplied explanation of how party competition could divide a worldwide community.
shortened: If a Baha'i works for one political party to overcome another it is a negation of the very spirit of the Faith. Membership in any political party, therefore, necessarily entails repudiation of some or all of the principles of peace and unity proclaimed by Baha'u'llah.

If a Baha'i were to insist on his right to support a certain political party, he could not deny the same degree of freedom to other believers. This would mean that within the ranks of the Faith, whose primary mission is to unite all men as one great family under God, there would be Baha'is opposed to each other. Where, then, would be the example of unity and harmony which the world is seeking?

order.why: Connect political abstention with rectitude of conduct.
Read the supplied account of the principle’s scope and loyalty to government.
shortened: And this principle is no other than that which involves the non-participation by the adherents of the Faith of Baha'u'llah, whether in their individual capacities or collectively as local or national Assemblies, in any form of activity that might be interpreted, either directly or indirectly, as an interference in the political affairs of any particular government.... Theirs is the duty to demonstrate, on one hand, the nonpolitical character of their Faith, and to assert, on the other, their unqualified loyalty and obedience to whatever is the considered judgment of their respective governments.

order.why: Consider obedience alongside the stated exception concerning spiritual principle.
shortened: ...we must do two things -- shun politics like the plague, and be obedient to the government in power in the place where we reside. We cannot start judging how a particular government came into power, and therefore whether we should obey it or not. This would immediately plunge us into politics. We must obey in all cases except where a spiritual principle is involved such as denying our Faith. For these spiritual principle we must be willing to die.

order.why: Read the commitment not to supersede constitutional government.
Keep the later explanation of constitutional means distinct from taking power.
Read the supplied historical account of future development with its omission preserved.
Keep the separately dated statement about a distant future in its own terms.
Consider the warning against importing factions into community administration.
Read the counsel against withdrawing from cooperation for constructive aims.
Close with willingness to work alongside associations serving all humanity.

Consider the different historical settings and the additional questions these Baha’i texts raise about party affiliation and community unity.
